patch_description: The current best achieves the reference squared ratio (~0.2400). To push beyond, add (1) more diverse random starts (nudged from the current best configuration, which empirically finds the best-known 14-point arrangement from many basins), and (2) a final direct Nelder-Mead polish on the *true* ratio after SLSQP, which can squeeze out small gains where the constrained SLSQP converges prematurely. The starts list is cheap and the NM polish on 42 variables with tight tolerances is fast.
